facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at P-3220 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 20 September 2025 an incident occurred on P-3220 and M-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
